module: PeopleSoft Travel & Expenses and Grants (EX / GM)
description: PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 Travel & Expenses sheets (`PS_EX_SHEET_HDR`, `PS_EX_SHEET_LINE`, `PS_EX_SHEET_DIST`) and Grants Management awards (`PS_GM_AWARD`).

tables.description: Stores employee travel and expense report headers.

columns.name: SHEET_STATUS
columns.description: Sheet status (SUB = Submitted for Approval, PD = Paid).

columns.name: TOTAL_AMT
columns.description: Total claimed expense amount in USD.

tables.description: Stores federal and state grant awards in Education & Government BU EGV05.

columns.name: CONTRACT_NUM
columns.description: Grant Award / Contract Number (NSF-ENG-2025-44, DOJ-JUST-2026, HHS-TANF-26-04).
